about: Baby size and development for pregnancy weeks 4 to 40. Lengths and development from each week's NHS page; weights from the WHO fetal growth chart (weeks 14 to 40 only). Nothing interpolated. Development text is our paraphrase, not a quote.

weeks.weightLabel: median estimated fetal weight from ultrasound; the range is the 10th to 90th percentile. Babies vary.

weeks.weightLabel: median estimated fetal weight from ultrasound; the range is the 10th to 90th percentile. Babies vary.

weeks.development: The arms and legs are now in proportion, and over the next weeks you may see the bump move when the baby kicks.
weeks.careNote: If the baby's movements slow down or stop, contact your care team right away; CDC lists this as an urgent warning sign.

weeks.weightLabel: median estimated fetal weight from ultrasound; the range is the 10th to 90th percentile. Babies vary.

weeks.weightLabel: median estimated fetal weight from ultrasound; the range is the 10th to 90th percentile. Babies vary.

weeks.development: This is an active time: a loud noise may make the baby jump, and the occasional hiccup may be felt.

weeks.weightLabel: median estimated fetal weight from ultrasound; the range is the 10th to 90th percentile. Babies vary.

weeks.weightLabel: median estimated fetal weight from ultrasound; the range is the 10th to 90th percentile. Babies vary.
